subject: Rebuilt back office, country rules on signup, and deploy emails
body:
Back office is now a real panel rather than one page of tabs:
- Grouped sidebar (collapsible, remembered) with sections instead of a flat
  list, a Ctrl/Cmd-K palette that searches customers and jumps to any page,
  and the actual signed-in admin in the footer.
- Dashboard with a 30-day signups chart: one series, one hue, zero days
  rendered as real zeros, hover readout, and a table view for anyone not
  using a pointer or colour.
- Systems that do not exist (deposits, KYC) show as dormant tiles, never as
  a "0" that implies the feature is wired up.
- Customers page is URL-driven, so a selected customer is a shareable link.
  Suspension now asks for confirmation, since it cuts access instantly.

Signup:
- Password field has a reveal toggle.
- Country of residence is required and validated server side against one
  shared list. The United States is not on it, so a direct POST of US is
  refused too.
- Choosing "Other" requires the customer to tick the sophisticated-trader
  declaration themselves; country and the declaration timestamp are stored
  as the record of what they claimed and when.

Deploys:
- The build writes dist/version.json; on boot the server records the commit
  and emails every admin once. The unique commit column means a restart, a
  second instance or a rollback stays quiet. Mail failures are logged and
  never block startup.
